title: Pilot study of the efficacy of nicotinamide (vitamin B3) in Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy - NICOLHON
official: Pilot study of the efficacy of nicotinamide (vitamin B3) in Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy - NICOLHON
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to evaluate the efficacy of administering 2 grams per day of nicotinamide for one year in patients who have developed NOHL due to the m.11778G>A or m.3460G>A mutation within the last 18 months
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients aged 16 years and older
2. Patients with NOHL due to a m.11778G>A or m.3460G>A mutation in mitochondrial DNA
3. Patients who are naïve (> 3 months) to nicotinamide treatment
4. Patients able to take oral medication and comply with specific study procedures
5. Patients affiliated with or beneficiaries of a social security system
6. Patients who have signed an informed consent form or parental consent form (or guardianship holders) for minors
Exclusion criteria:
1. Asymptomatic patients (= healthy carriers of a m.11778G>A or m.3460G>A mutation in mitochondrial DNA but who have not developed optic neuropathy)
2. Persons deprived of their liberty by administrative or judicial decision
3. Patients subject to legal protection measures
4. Persons undergoing compulsory psychiatric care
5. Individuals unable to express consent
6. Patients already included in an interventional study modifying the management of NOHL
7. Patients with symptomatic or asymptomatic LOHN caused by another mitochondrial DNA mutation or a nuclear DNA mutation
8. Patients with NOHL for more than 18 months
9. Patients taking idebenone or who have stopped treatment less than 3 months ago
10. Patients with another severe associated ophthalmological condition (advanced glaucoma, retinal disease, etc.)
11. Patients treated with gene therapy
12. Patients with transaminase (AST and/or ALT) levels twice the upper normal limit
13. Pregnant women, breastfeeding women, or women in labor
14. Patients with a contraindication to nicotinamide, an allergy or intolerance to lactose or galactose
